additional_concerns: The scope adds nav > 0 without express source support. It returns OUT_OF_SCOPE for zero or negative NAV even where an applicable SFC designation exists. Resolve this computational assumption separately from legal scope.
Under exact arithmetic and positive NAV, doubling total exposure correctly implements the inclusive 50% threshold; it is not double-counting.

The referenced supplied exposure methodology is absent. Look-through, derivative measurement, netting, valuation and assessment timing remain unresolved; the formula does not establish the correctness of its supplied inputs.
The three unbound dependency IDs have no supplied mapping to named authorities. None may be assigned by inference.

Missing external materials also include the separate LAF circular, the Internal Product Approval Process circular and the Advertising Guidelines. Their absence does not prevent this narrow classification assessment, but prevents assessing their separate requirements.

A FALSE classification result does not establish investment-limit, disclosure, distributor or sale compliance. The circular does not specify measurement dates, later threshold-change treatment or a classification grace period.

The global CONFLICT rule can block an otherwise established classification route because another branch contains conflicting facts. This is a declared evidence-handling restriction, not a requirement stated by the circular.

The contextual instrument descriptions and discretionary factors remain relevant to human input assessment. Their treatment here must not authorize pruning them from a broader classification or compliance workflow.
